# IMPERIA COLD WAR: War Measures v3 (24.11.2026): crimes, evidence, exposure, observers, peacekeepers.
# Generated by E:/HOI4_Mod_Tools/mdcoldwar/development/tools/war_measures/war_measures_build.py; edit the generator.

on_actions = {
	# Monthly, per country; every block stops at its first check for countries without the system.
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_WM_month } check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_market_shock > 0 } }
				set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_WM_month days = 27 value = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_market_shock = 0.85 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_market_shock < 0.5 } } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_market_shock = 0 } }
			}
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no has_war = yes } COLDWAR_WM_preview_war_states = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_exposure > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_decay = 5 }
				if = { limit = { has_war = yes } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_decay = 2 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_hosts^num > 0 } } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_decay = 2 } }
				subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_exposure = COLDWAR_WM_decay }
				clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_WM_exposure min = 0 max = 100 }
				COLDWAR_WM_update_stage = yes
			}
			# mission costs are paid through MD's weekly budget (COLDWAR_WM_add_weekly_mission_expenses)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_shoot^num > 0 } }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = COLDWAR_PK_shoot
					if = { limit = { has_war = no } add_to_temp_array = { COLDWAR_PK_off = THIS } }
				}
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = COLDWAR_PK_off
					save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_tgt
					PREV = { COLDWAR_PK_stand_down = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# A war starts (ROOT and FROM are the two sides): previews for the players' war states.
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } COLDWAR_WM_preview_war_states = yes }
			FROM = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } COLDWAR_WM_preview_war_states = yes } }
		}
	}
	# ROOT = new controller, FROM.FROM = the state. Tripwire: a peacekeeping zone falls to an enemy of its owner.
	on_state_control_changed = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { is_ai = no FROM = { is_ai = no } } }
				FROM.FROM = { COLDWAR_WM_preview_state = yes }
			}
			FROM.FROM = {
				# a Free Fire Zone and a defoliation serve only the country that ordered them
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_free_fire }
						has_variable = COLDWAR_WM_by
						NOT = { var:COLDWAR_WM_by = { tag = ROOT } }
					}
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_free_fire }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_defoliation }
						has_variable = COLDWAR_WM_by
						var:COLDWAR_WM_by = { OR = { tag = ROOT NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } }
					}
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_defoliation }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone
						NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
						OWNER = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_variable = COLDWAR_PK_sender
					}
					COLDWAR_PK_overrun = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
